newTable.name: ai_quota_reservation

fields.generation: varchar(255), nullable only until atomic reserve identity known
fields.state: PREPARED / RESERVED / REFUND_DUE / RETAINED / REFUNDED / RESOLVED_NO_ACTIVE_RESERVATION / UNCERTAIN
fields.decision_reason: fixed internal code, never raw prompts/images/provider output
fields.request_lease_token: char(32), fences live request against recovery
fields.request_lease_until: datetime(3), stale does not by itself prove refund eligibility

newTable.retention: No automatic deletion or invented retention rule in this repair. Production migration and job enablement remain deployment gates.

newInternalSignatures: AiQuotaReservationRecord prepare(Long memberId, String bizType, String pool, String originalDay, String counterKey, String nonce, String receiptKey); // independent short committed transaction before Redis charge

boolean recordReserved(Long id, String requestLeaseToken, String generation, long used); // nonce-bound identity returned by same reserve EVAL or matching receipt, never standalone current-generation read
boolean advanceStage(Long id, String requestLeaseToken, String stage); // CAS before review/model side effect
boolean retain(Long id, String requestLeaseToken, String decisionReason); // success or existing no-refund outcome persisted before returning it
boolean requireRefund(Long id, String requestLeaseToken, String reason); // durable definitive failure intent before best-effort Redis refund
List<AiQuotaReservationRecord> claimDue(int limit, String ownerToken); // short DB transaction; deterministic due+id order, fence+claim expiry
void reconcileClaim(AiQuotaReservationRecord row); // Redis outside DB transaction; completion WHERE id/state/owner/fence
AiQuotaRecoveryTask.run(); // existing Quartz bean mechanism, no new external endpoint
flow: 1. Freeze original member/pool/K/day/nonce and commit PREPARED before Redis. If DB preparation fails, no quota mutation; ordinary/player fail as upstream unavailable, Photo retains existing unmetered fallback.

2. Reserve Lua keeps current counter/generation rules and returns count+generation in one EVAL. Avoid guessing generation from nonce when K already exists. For lost response, inspect only this receipt; persist resolved identity if available; no bare current G substitution.

3. An independent committed stage update precedes external moderation/model. Request outcome writes use owner CAS. Player draft retention remains at Creator valid-draft boundary, not Gateway output; Photo invalid parse remains its existing retained policy; ordinary output/review retain current behavior.

4. Definitive service failure writes REFUND_DUE durably before Redis compensation. A crash after this point is recoverable from DB. Refund attempts only exact original K+G+R. Keep original nonce cancellation and generation checks; never decrement only because DB stores old generation.

5. Worker claims small due batch and releases DB transaction before Redis network work. Success/final-no-active result uses fenced CAS. Transient failure persists next attempt; no blind three-attempt deletion or false completion. Losing completion response retries same nonce idempotently.

6. Missing K resolves without creating K or touching another date. Generation mismatch resolves old claim without debit. Missing receipt while K remains is UNCERTAIN unless the script conclusively proves not applied/cancelled: durable generation alone is insufficient to repeat a decrement after a prior refund marker expired.

7. After crash, stale PREPARED before review ever started can safely cancel its own reservation and resolve no user output/violation. Stale records after INPUT_REVIEW_STARTED or MODEL_STARTED without authoritative terminal outcome must remain UNCERTAIN: stage timeout cannot distinguish service failure from completed violation/success. Do not infer from absent audit row.
atomicReturnPlan: Successor may change reserve Lua internal return to [used,generation], using explicit per-execution StringRedisSerializer for returned generation and the existing production argument serializer. Both business callers adapt together. No global serializer/config change; current frozen v1 remains Long return. A matching receipt GET for a lost reply must parse gen from that exact nonce receipt, not from K:generation.
nonNegotiableEvidenceLimits: Cannot guarantee arbitrary process crash exact business outcome with no durable terminal write. Crash after moderation decides violation but before decision persistence is intrinsically unclassified; automatic refund would violate approved no-refund policy.
If DB and Redis both fail before a terminal fact is durable, preserve UNCERTAIN and report pending evidence. This is a technical cut point, not a new user policy question.
Current 172800-second cancel-marker lifetime is finite. A durable worker must not fall back to direct decrement using DB identity when receipt/cancel evidence has expired.
An expired original quota counter means no current-day quota is owed under the existing date-key policy; record no-active resolution, do not grant extra new-day allowance.
No production migration, scheduling or recovery has occurred; this is a proposal only.
acceptance: Random task MySQL schema, CREATE-success flag before DROP; loopback task Redis with exact absent-before-use random keys; production Redis serializer.
Persist PREPARED then crash after Lua apply before returned identity: restart reads exact receipt, resolves/cancels only its own original reservation.
Persist REFUND_DUE, force Redis outage across process restart, restore Redis: same K/nonce decremented once, independent SQL+raw Redis readback.
Lua refund applied but reply lost; DB still REFUND_DUE: retry observes same nonce finalization and never debits B.
A reserve, K deleted, B recreated same date: A recovery cannot debit B; repeat with generation-only loss.
Original day expires while recovery blocked: next-day counter unchanged, old counter never recreated.
Concurrent workers and expired claim takeover: exactly one current owner can finalize DB; repeated Redis calls remain same nonce idempotent.
Explicit INPUT_BLOCKED and valid success retained, no recovery debit; REVIEW and Photo invalid-result policies retain prior behavior.
Crash after INPUT_REVIEW_STARTED with no authoritative terminal decision: UNCERTAIN, no automatic debit or false recovered status.
DB prepare failure produces no Redis charge; Photo existing unmetered behavior kept.
Continuous outage leaves pending and bounded scheduled retries, never marks refunded; one failing early row must not starve later due rows.
Actual Quartz schedule enablement and device/HTTP acceptance remain separate deployment evidence.
